Frequently Asked Questions

x Presale & Buying
How do I buy PHN in the presale?
1. Go to peaqhumannode.netlify.app/buy
2. Connect your MetaMask wallet
3. Switch to peaq network (Chain ID 3338) or BSC
4. Enter the amount of PEAQ or USDC you want to spend
5. Review the PHN you will receive (98% after 2% fee)
6. Click Buy and confirm in MetaMask

PHN will appear in your wallet immediately after the transaction confirms.
What is an epoch and when does the price change?
An epoch is a presale pricing round. Each epoch has a fixed price and a 5M PHN cap.

When all 5M tokens in Epoch 1 are sold, the price automatically advances to Epoch 2 permanently.

Epochs: $0.02 $0.05 $0.10 $0.20

There is no way to buy at a previous epoch price once it has closed.
What is the 2% fee on purchases?
Every PHN purchase incurs a 2% fee on the PHN amount:

0.25% permanently burned via ERC20Burnable.burn() reduces total supply forever
1.75% treasury wallet for project development
98% you receive this

The burn amount is shown in the presale calculator before you confirm.
Which networks and currencies can I use to buy?
Phase 1 (now): peaq Mainnet PEAQ native token + USDC
Phase 2 (soon): BSC BNB + USDC
Phase 3 (future): Ethereum, BTC via bridge

Add peaq network to MetaMask: Chain ID 3338, RPC https://peaq.api.onfinality.io/public
I sent the transaction but don't see PHN in my wallet.
PHN may not show automatically you need to add it to MetaMask manually:

1. Open MetaMask Assets Import token
2. Token contract: 0x83e2A4aB24A61d138f12569c497C3E5f2BF8694B
3. Symbol: PHN | Decimals: 18

Or use the "Add to Wallet" button on our verify page. If the transaction failed, check BscScan for error details.
a Staking
What are the staking tiers?
PHN offers 3 staking tiers:

FLEX 8% APY, no lock period, unstake anytime
LOCKED 15% APY, 90-day lock, 50% reward penalty for early exit
VAULT 25% APY, 180-day lock, 100% reward penalty for early exit

Rewards accrue per second. The longer you lock, the higher the yield.
When will staking go live?
PHNStaking.sol is written and ready. Deployment requires a small amount of BNB for gas (~0.02 BNB).

Once deployed, the staking contract address will be updated in staking.html and announced on Telegram.
Where do staking rewards come from?
The Staking Rewards Pool holds 10,000,000 PHN (10% of total supply), allocated from the tokenomics. This pool is pre-funded at contract deployment and disbursed per second to active stakers based on tier APY.

Rewards are real PHN transfers from the pool not synthetic tokens.
x Node Operation
What are the requirements to run a PHN node?
Requirements:
A personal computer (not a VM or cloud server hardware fingerprinting detects this)
A peaq wallet with enough PEAQ for gas
Completed identity verification (human attestation + peaq DID)
Node software installed (available on the Activate Node page)

Nodes earn PHN for every "heartbeat" transaction sent to the network. No staking or collateral required.
Can I run multiple nodes?
Each node requires a unique hardware identity. Running multiple nodes on different physical machines is allowed but bots, VMs, and duplicate hardware fingerprints are rejected by the NodeIdentityRegistry contract.
x Security & Wallets
Is the PHN contract audited?
The contracts are built with OpenZeppelin v5 libraries (industry-standard, battle-tested). A formal third-party audit is planned. In the meantime, all contract source code is visible on BscScan after verification.

Contract: 0x83e2A4aB24A61d138f12569c497C3E5f2BF8694B
View on BscScan
How do I add PHN to MetaMask?
Method 1 (automatic): Click "Add PHN to Wallet" on the verify page.

Method 2 (manual):
1. MetaMask Add Token Custom Token
2. Contract: 0x83e2A4aB24A61d138f12569c497C3E5f2BF8694B
3. Symbol: PHN | Decimals: 18
4. Click Add Token
The team DMed me asking for funds is this legitimate?
NO. This is a scam.

The PHN team will NEVER:
DM you first on any platform
Ask for your seed phrase, private key, or password
Ask you to send crypto to "verify" your wallet
Offer private sales, refunds, or special deals via DM

Report scammers to: t.me/PeaqHumanNode (tag an admin)
